question: What predeclared test compares a UD signed-force forecast with an ordinary moiré baseline using correlated uncertainties?
assumptions: frozen simple H0/H1 signed force mean vectors
common fixed symmetric positive-definite Gaussian covariance
physical_mapping: OPEN: no measured forces or UD source, material loss and clock map
target_exposure: paired angles and weak load response known before construction; no force table read
fitted_choices: alpha=1/20 and target power=4/5 declared protocol choices; no graphite fit
sources: Chen et al. Phys Rev Lett 137 166201 (2026) DOI 10.1103/ly48-b4l2, public abstract checked 2026-11-02
baseline: frozen conventional moiré plus contact and bath signed force mu0
result: exact likelihood improvement and Gaussian size/power; synthetic d^2=4/3 and nominal power about 0.312 at alpha 0.05
next_discriminant: freeze physically sourced mu1 and Sigma independently; obtain new measured signed force vectors
